name: Running warm-up
goal: Get your heart, muscles and tendons ready to run in about 12 minutes, with dynamic movements only (save long static stretches for after).
whoFor: Anyone before an easy run, a workout or a race. Shorten it to the jog and leg swings on easy days if you're short of time.

items.note: Or a brisk walk if you're coming back from an injury.
Skip if a calf, Achilles or foot tendon is sore.
Before workouts and races. Skip on easy days.
